items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses to go ahead of the people, bring some of the elders of Israel, and carry the rod he had used to strike the river.
items.action: commanded Moses to go on before the people with elders and his rod
items.object: Moses; elders of Israel; the rod wherewith he smote the river
